title: Smashed Black Bean and Avocado Tacos
summary: Warm corn tortillas with cumin-spiced smashed black beans, creamy avocado, lime-pickled onion and cilantro. A meatless taco night in twenty minutes.

creator.bio: Sample creator. Everyday Mexican family cooking: tacos, rice and slow-simmered sauces.

steps.instruction: Toss the sliced red onion with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt. Set aside while you cook.
success_cues: Onion starts turning pink and softening
warnings: Sharp knife: curl your fingertips under and keep the board steady on a damp towel.
steps.creator_note: Quick lime onions wake up every taco. Don't skip them.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the beans, cumin and a splash of water and cook 3 minutes, then smash about half with a fork.
success_cues: Beans are hot and partly mashed into a thick, spreadable mix
warnings: Hot oil can spit; add food away from your body and keep the handle turned inward.

steps.instruction: Warm the tortillas one at a time in a dry pan over medium-high heat, about 30 seconds per side, and stack them in a towel.
success_cues: Tortillas are soft and pliable with a few toasted spots
warnings: Use tongs; the dry pan gets very hot.

steps.instruction: Slice the avocado and squeeze over the remaining lime juice.
success_cues: Avocado slices are glossy with lime and not browning
warnings: Sharp knife: curl your fingertips under and keep the board steady on a damp towel.

steps.instruction: Fill each tortilla with beans, avocado, pickled onion, cilantro and queso fresco if using.
success_cues: Each taco has a layer of beans and a bit of every topping

creator_notes: Skip the queso fresco and the tacos are vegan.
dietary_warnings: Optional queso fresco contains milk. Check corn tortilla labels if you avoid wheat.
